summary: Mr. Terzi examines the connection between the calendar placement of Tisha B'Ab, the parasha of Devarim, and the haftarah of Chazon Yeshayahu. He explores themes of interpersonal relations and relations with Hashem through these texts, and discusses how the structure of the calendar encourages us to carry these lessons forward into the coming weeks.
questions: Why is Tisha B'Ab placed before Parashat Vaethanan in the calendar?
How do the themes of the haftarah of Chazon Yeshayahu connect to the parasha of Devarim?
What is the significance of the word Eicha appearing in the Torah and the prophets?
How does the calendar structure help us move forward after Tisha B'Ab?
What is the relationship between mishpat and tzedek and the redemption?
